summary: difference over a statically analyzable set-like object using its keys iterator.

semantics.path: invoke known other.keys with other as this and iterate returned iterator
semantics.iterator_close: preserve canonical iterator close when algorithm exits early

tests.name: keys this binding
tests.input: const o={size:1,tag:2,*keys(){yield this.tag},has(){return false}}; const a=new Set([1,2,3]); console.log([...a.difference(o)]);
tests.expected_behavior: keys is invoked with other as this

tests.name: duplicate keys tolerated
tests.input: const o={size:1,*keys(){yield 2;yield 2},has(){return false}}; const a=new Set([1,2,3]); console.log([...a.difference(o)]);
tests.expected_behavior: duplicate keys cannot create duplicate Set entries
